onboarding.calibration_body: Waa kuwan toban dalab oo firfircoon, iyo waxa Dawnlist ka gorfeeyay mid kasta. Sax wixii uu qaldamay. Meesha aad ku khilaafsan tahay, u sheeg jumlada haddii lagu daro warqadaada gaaban ay saxi lahayd — jumladaas ayaa gelaysa warqadaada gaaban, si khaladkaas aan berri dib loogu soo celin.
onboarding.sentence_placeholder: Jumlada la geliyo warqadaada gaaban, ee tan sax lahaa waa maxay?
onboarding.finish: Dhammayso oo bilow socodka maalinlaha ah
onboarding.ready: Diyaar — warqadaada gaaban waxaa lagu cusboonaysiin doonaa waxa aad bartay.
onboarding.low_signal: Waxaad ku raacday wax kasta, taasoo caadi ahaan macnaheedu yahay tijaabadan inay fudud tahay, ee maaha in warqadda gaabani dhammaystiran tahay.
onboarding.disagreement: Ma raacsanid — Dawnlist waxay tidhi {app}, adiguna waxaad tidhi {user}.

settings.title: Dawnlist — dejinta
settings.key_body: Dawnlist wuxuu akhriyaa dhaqdhaqaaqyada shaqada oo qoraa fariimahaaga isagoo isticmaalaya moodelada Anthropic, iyadoo lagu shaqaynayo akoonkaaga gaarka ah. Samee furaha console.anthropic.com kadibna ku dhex qor halkan. Waad ka baabi'in kartaa wakhti kasta, Dawnlist-na wuxuu ku kaydiyaa maareeyaha xogta aqoonsiga ee nidaamkaaga hawlgalka — marnaba fayl kuma kaydiyo.
settings.key_none: Weli ma jiro furaha la kaydiyay — Dawnlist ma shaqayn karo iyada la'aanteed.
settings.licence_body: Ku dhex qor furaha shatiga ee ku yimid emailkaaga iibsiga. Haddii lagu siiyay xeer sokeeye (override code) halkii shati, sidaas ku dhex qor — Dawnlist ayaa ku badali doona shati.
settings.licence_none: Weli ma jiro shati la kaydiyay.
settings.code_redeemed: Xeerka waa la aqbalay — shatigaaga waa la kaydiyay.
onboarding.interview_body: Dawnlist wuxuu akhriyay CV-yadaada oo diyaariyay laba dukumeenti. Saxee — waa bilow, mana aha go'aan kama dambays ah. Xaqiiqda dhinaca bidix ah waa waxa kaliya ee wixii soo saarista shaqadaadu (outreach) ay ku sheegi karto ku saabsan adiga. Warbixinta ku habboon ee dhinaca midig ayaa go'aamisa waxa la soo bandhigo subax kasta.
onboarding.factsheet_label: Xaqiiqda asalka — waxa la sheegi karo
onboarding.brief_label: Warbixinta ku habboonaanta — waxa la soo bandhigo
onboarding.drafted: Waa la diyaariyay. Sax wax kasta oo qalad ah ka hor inta aadan sii socon.
onboarding.draft_failed: Lama diyaarin karin CV-yadaada: {reason}. Waxaad qofkeenu ku qori kartaa labada dukumeenti oo aad sii socoto.
